class_ndim_norm — SEGMENTATION classify op

• Data kinds: images × table → mask

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.class_ndim_norm(feature_images, model, thresh=3.0) (implementation को सीधे call करना हो तो import segmentation; segmentation.class_ndim_norm(feature_images, model, thresh=3.0), registry से लेना हो तो opssegmentation.get("class_ndim_norm"))

उपयोग

ND feature image को सीखी गई normal distribution class से classify करता है (Mahalanobis दूरी < thresh) (class_ndim_norm)। feature_images: (H,W,D) या D 2D image।
